title: A Hybrid SMT-NRA Solver: Integrating 2D Cell-Jump-Based Local Search, MCSAT and OpenCAD
abstract: arXiv:2507.00557v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper, we propose a hybrid framework for Satisfiability Modulo the Theory of Nonlinear Real Arithmetic (SMT-NRA for short). First, we introduce a two-dimensional cell-jump move, called \emph{2D-cell-jump}, generalizing the key operation, cell-jump, of the local search method for SMT-NRA. In contrast to the existing cell-jump, which updates assignments exclusively along a given line, the 2D-cell-jump enables search over an arbitrarily selected plane. Then, we propose an extended local search framework, named \emph{2D-LS} (following the existing local search framework, LS, for SMT-NRA). Finally, we present a hybrid framework for SMT-NRA integrating 2D-LS, MCSAT and OpenCAD, to improve search efficiency through information exchange. The experimental results demonstrate improvements in local search performance, highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

translated_title: 一种混合式SMT-NRA求解器：集成基于二维单元格跳跃的局部搜索、MCSAT与OpenCAD
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种针对非线性实数算术理论上的可满足性模理论（简称SMT-NRA）的混合框架。首先，我们引入了一种二维单元格跳跃移动，称为"2D-cell-jump"（二维单元格跳跃），它是对SMT-NRA局部搜索方法中关键操作——单元格跳跃的推广。与现有的仅在给定直线上更新赋值的单元格跳跃不同，2D-cell-jump能够在任意选定的平面上进行搜索。随后，我们提出了一个扩展的局部搜索框架，命名为"2D-LS"（沿袭现有的SMT-NRA局部搜索框架LS）。最后，我们提出了一个集成2D-LS、MCSAT和OpenCAD的SMT-NRA混合框架，通过信息交换来提升搜索效率。实验结果表明局部搜索性能得到了改进，凸显了所提方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种将基于二维单元格跳跃的局部搜索（2D-LS）与MCSAT和OpenCAD相集成的混合SMT-NRA求解框架，通过将单元格跳跃操作从一维直线推广到二维平面搜索，并借助信息交换机制，有效提升了搜索效率和局部搜索性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid SMT-NRA solver framework that integrates 2D cell-jump-based local search (2D-LS) with MCSAT and OpenCAD, generalizing the cell-jump operation from one-dimensional lines to arbitrarily selected planes and improving search efficiency through information exchange.
